description: FamilySearch record_read for the 1893 Turany (Turócz County, today Slovakia) Lutheran parish baptism of Jan Gallo — the hit returned by record-search-gallo-slovakia-hit. Names father Andrej Gallo and mother Katarina Križko, with the family resident at Šútovo in Turany parish. Paired with that search fixture because search-records legitimately opens its top hit with record_read (the tool is in its allowed-tools) before reporting; without a record_read fixture the call is unregistered and the run aborts Type 1 (unmatched_tool_call) instead of being graded. Predicate is a substring match on the entity ID so it fires whether the skill passes the full ARK or the bare ID.
